name: westwood_online_upgrade_dialog_scalar_deleting_destructor
description: WestwoodOnlineUpgradeDialog::ScalarDeletingDestructor runs the dialog destructor, optionally deletes the object when bit 0 is set, and returns the original this pointer.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja disassembly for 0x43d980 validates calling WestwoodOnlineUpgradeDialog::Destructor, testing bit 0 of the flags argument, conditionally calling operator delete, returning the original this pointer, and callee cleanup for the flags argument.

Native smoke westwood_online_upgrade_dialog_destructor_smoke verifies scalar deleting destructor return value and destructor sequence for flags 0, then allocates heap storage and verifies the flags 1 path executes the same destructor sequence and returns the original pointer while allowing operator delete to run.
